title: Fasten a bracket bolt with a ratchet in confined access
instruction: Pick up the ratchet from its cradle, fit the socket onto the started bracket bolt, then tighten it with short back-and-forth strokes between the walls until the bolt is seated.
context: Confined maintenance work requires repeated short drive and return strokes when surrounding structure prevents a full wrench turn.
setup: Dual YAM station. Both arms start at their rest pose with open grippers. A 203 mm steel ratchet with a permanently fitted 13.4 mm AF socket rests on a painted-steel cradle. An M8x16 steel bolt (1.25 mm pitch, 14 g) is already threaded into a fixed steel receiver under a 3 mm bracket with a 2.5 mm gap. Two 162 mm high, 9 mm thick steel walls restrict swing to about ±16 degrees. Flat rubber grip pads provide purchase. The reference demo uses the right arm; the left stays at rest. Exact geometry and poses are in the source.
scoring: Current-state score from the 2.5 mm initial under-head gap: 0.2 for >=0.3125 mm axial advance; 0.4 for >=1.25 mm; 0.7 for actual head/bracket surface contact; 1.0 after 0.5 s continuous seating. Thread integrity is required. Loss of seating removes seating credit. Torque and cycles are diagnostic only. Numerical contact, penetration, nonfinite-state and fixture-displacement checks are in README. Measure initial/final gap and inspect the exposed interface in physical trials.
reset_notes: Reset restores both arms to READY with open fingers, the ratchet to its cradle and the started bolt to its receiver. Only the bolt uses a reset placement jig, which is removed before actions.
fidelity: NVIDIA ratchet visuals plus original socket, bolt, grip pads, cradle and fixture. Physical contacts support pickup and transmit torque. A native clutch and pitch joint drive travel; thread ridges are visual. Seating requires measured head-underside/bracket-top impulse, separation and geometry checks. Deformation, fastener strength and clamp preload are not modeled. Both arms start at rest, tool separate from bolt; no hand/tool or socket/bolt attachments. Demo uses simulator pose feedback.
scores: Demo: 1.0 (3,150 actions); repeat: 1.0 (3,150 actions); Dream-1: 0.0 (4,000 actions). Attached demo and Dream videos use the same frozen source, assets and seed 17.
